product.Caption: Commercial General Liability
product.Description: ISO-style Commercial General Liability policy (CG 00 01) covering bodily injury and property damage liability (Coverage A), personal and advertising injury liability (Coverage B), and medical payments (Coverage C) on an occurrence trigger.

coverage.Section: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability

coverage.Section: Coverage B — Personal & Advertising Injury Liability

value.notes: Base limit — minimal coverage for most operations

form.CoveragePart: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability
Coverage B — Personal & Advertising Injury Liability
form.Description: ISO occurrence-trigger CGL base form providing Coverage A (BI/PD), Coverage B (Personal and Advertising Injury), and Coverage C (Medical Payments). Each-Occurrence Limit caps any single occurrence; General Aggregate caps all non-PCO loss; Products-Completed-Operations Aggregate caps PCO loss. Both aggregates reset each policy period.
Declarations page showing named insured, business description, class codes, exposure bases, limits of insurance, premium, and applicable endorsement schedule.

field.name: ClassCode
field.notes: ISO classification code for each premises/operations exposure.

field.name: ExposureAmount
field.notes: Annual payroll or gross sales for the corresponding class code.

form.Form: Additional Insured — Owners, Lessees or Contractors
form.CoveragePart: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability
form.Description: Adds a named owner, lessee or contractor as an additional insured for ongoing operations performed for that party. Limits coverage to the insured's negligence and excludes the additional insured's own acts.

form.Form: Additional Insured — Owners, Lessees or Contractors — Products-Completed Operations
form.CoveragePart: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability
form.Description: Extends Coverage A Products-Completed-Operations to a named additional insured. Required when products-completed-operations coverage is elected [GL.FORM.RU.001].

form.CoveragePart: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability
form.Description: Establishes a per-occurrence deductible for Coverage A bodily injury and property damage claims. Attaches when a BI/PD deductible is elected [GL.FORM.RU.002].

form.Form: Exclusion — Access or Disclosure of Confidential or Personal Information
form.CoveragePart: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability
Coverage B — Personal & Advertising Injury Liability
form.Description: Excludes liability arising out of the access to or disclosure of confidential or personal information. Applies to Coverage A and B.

form.CoveragePart: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability
Coverage B — Personal & Advertising Injury Liability
form.Description: Excludes all liability arising out of actual or alleged exposure to, ingestion of, inhalation of or contact with fungi or bacteria, including mold.

form.CoveragePart: Coverage A — Bodily Injury & Property Damage Liability
form.Description: Excludes liability arising out of the rendering of or failure to render professional services as an architect, engineer or surveyor. Applies to contractor accounts only.
